description: Estimate the subscription capacity required for a download using the audience version, selected fields, output settings, and current licenses. Saves a pending estimate and updates the audience estimate reference. Returns an expected amount and an upper bound, denominated in USD, together with available-capacity sufficiency and any shortfall. Active licenses reduce the expected identity component. When license information is unavailable, the expected amount equals the upper bound. The matching component for a file upload is included when applicable. Review the expected amount and upper bound with the user before delivery. Requires 'discovery' scope.

destination.description: Active delivery destination; partner pushes are not yet available

output_compression.description: Requested download compression. gzip supports csv/json/jsonl; Avro uses native DEFLATE.

name: quote_delivery

cost_estimate.description: Expected subscription capacity consumption, denominated in USD

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

max_cost_estimate.description: Upper bound for subscription capacity consumption, denominated in USD

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions
